task: Design a one-hour prototype to decide whether a streaming import approach is feasible under the stated constraints. No execution tools are available; return the experiment and decision rules.
context: Target input: newline-delimited records totaling up to 2 GiB; individual records can be up to 1 MiB. The import must stay below 64 MiB peak memory and produce its first valid record within 500 ms in the intended environment. Correct output must match a reference parser on the supported format. A proposed dashboard and production storage integration are not needed for the feasibility decision. Synthetic input generation is allowed. No current parser measurements are supplied.
expected: Separately varies total input size and individual record size while preserving the parsing mechanism.
Uses the 64 MiB and 500 ms thresholds and includes correctness comparison against the reference parser.
Keeps the experiment isolated and within one hour, and states no execution results have been observed.
forbidden: Building a dashboard or full production integration as the experiment.
Claiming the streaming approach meets thresholds without running it.
evidence: Experiment setup, representative/limiting inputs, controls, explicit decision rules, budget and stated limitations.
